author: Vox
description:
Picture a black hole, and you probably see a hole in space that you could fall into. Astrophysicist Dr. Becky Smethurst says that’s not quite right because black holes actually aren’t holes at all. They’re massive amounts of matter packed so densely that they bend space around them.
